reply.description: What the owner reads, in their language; short, with #N for tasks.

escalate.description: true to answer this turn again with a stronger model, e.g. for a code question.

actions.description: Changes proposed to the owner, each shown as a button they tap to confirm; empty when nothing is proposed.

task.description: The task number, for every type but draft.

project.description: draft: the project's name or alias, when known.

text.description: draft: the whole request; followUp: the instruction; answer: an own answer.

option.description: answer: the chosen option's number, from 1.

decide.description: answer: true to let the agent decide.
